reasoning.text: Reference-class/base-rate: this administered-benefit line has recently moved in very smooth monthly steps. The last four month-to-month changes are +10.5, +10.4, +10.4, and +10.3 billion, so a one-month extrapolation is a strong baseline.

I use an 80% interval of +/-6.0 around the point to allow first-print source-data noise and possible BEA monthly allocation changes.
